release_notes:
Star Soft Enterprise v4.0.66 Release Notes (19-Nov-2026 12:20 PM):
- Recent Bills 'Settle Due' in Browser Web Client v1.8.1 now opens the dedicated Bill Settlement module directly with the selected invoice & payment history loaded.
- Eliminated all browser prompt() dialogs across Web Client v1.8.1 (Product Add/Edit, HSN/Brand/Tax/Location Masters, Credit Reminder Collect/Reschedule, and POS Item Quantity) using styled Apple Liquid-Glass modals.
- Full Server Master Print Setup & Company Logo synchronization across Browser Web Client v1.8.1, Android v1.8.1 (Build 11), and --mobile-server (5-sec PostgreSQL refresh for company logo, print layouts, thermal 80mm/58mm / A4 / A5 format, offline UPI QR /qr.png, and heartbeat print_profile_sig auto-resync).
